blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · I’ve been wearing the Gatherall bra fo…
blocks_element.text: I’ve been wearing the Gatherall bra for years now, and I can’t believe I’m only now writing a review. The design is so supportive and flattering, and this is pretty much the ONLY adhesive backless bra that has stayed on hot sweaty days, at packed bars, or under fancy dresses. I’ve tried alternatives like cakes and nippies (which aren’t bad! I love my cakes nipple covers, just not their lifting bra), and Gatherall just keeps outperforming the others. I’m a 34DD and this provides the coverage, comfort, and lift I need to feel confident in tanks and strapless tops. I’ll be a loyal customer for years to come and am so happy that a solution like this exists.
